definitions.top10/30/50/100: ranked by 0-10 composite within the 6+ criteria universe, gated on market cap > 2000cr and 0 < peg_eff < 2.0 (not backfilled); ties -> criteria count -> market cap
definitions.strong_buy: composite >= 8.0 AND (score >= 6 OR perfect) -- site 'Strong' segment
definitions.buy_plus: composite >= 6.5 AND (score >= 6 OR perfect) -- site 'Buy+' segment
